subject: [PATCH v3 4/6] btrfs: pre-allocate delayed dir index before btree modification

2026-08-11.patch_summary: This patch modifies the Btrfs file system to pre-allocate delayed directory index space before modifying the btree, preventing potential ENOMEM failures that could leave the btree in an inconsistent state. The allocation is now done in the btrfs_insert_dir_item function and can be optionally provided by the caller. The patch also removes a wrapper function for inserting delayed dir indices and updates various files to reflect these changes.
